snippet.title: Mandate Order| Annoucement
snippet.description:
Mandate Order is a simulation and construction game set in ancient China. It will be participating in the Steam Next Fest.

A playable demo is coming. Don't forget the wishlist if you like it.

#manorlords  #cityplannerplays #indiegame #indiegamedev

steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733690/_/
